//: Baseline of KNOWN-NOT-PASSING core tests on a clean tree, captured to make "no new test failures" a trustworthy gate despite a non-deterministic (sharded, memory-pressured) suite.
capturedFrom: 2 full runs of run-vitest.mjs (4-way shard) on 2026-08-17, clean core tree, FULLY BUILT workspace; both runs green (43,894 tests, 0 failures) so intersection=stable={} and symmetric-diff=flaky={}. The prior capture (eb412177b, 2026-05-31) recorded 90 deterministic failures; all 90 pass now, 3,413 commits and 956 core commits later, so they were reseeded away as GENUINELY RESOLVED rather than to make a red run green.

flakyFiles.//: Whole files that pass in isolation but flake under sharded memory/timing pressure — any failure within these is IGNORED by the gate. KEPT DELIBERATELY at the 2026-08-17 recapture: two green runs are not evidence these files never flake — they flake under shard memory/timing pressure, which depends on machine load, and this capture ran with more headroom than CI. Emptying the list would turn a future flake into a blocked push.

stableFailures.//: Deterministic pre-existing failures (failed in BOTH runs, outside flaky files) — IGNORED; a NEW failure is one not in this list and not in a flaky file.
